description: Human-labeled golden dataset for measuring real audit accuracy (Accuracy/Precision/Recall/F1) after the RAG accuracy overhaul (Phases 1-9). Distinct from tests/run_evals.py, which stays as a fast 4-scenario regression smoke test -- this is the larger validation asset the plan calls for. Seeded with the same 4 already-human-verified scenarios from tests/run_evals.py as a starting point (see 'source' on each case) -- these alone are NOT enough to draw real accuracy conclusions. Add more real labeled examples over time: aim for ~30-50 examples across ~15-20 controls covering all four quadrants (policy+evidence compliant, policy-only, evidence-only, neither) before trusting the aggregate numbers this produces.

cases.document_text: Section 8.5: Secure Authentication. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is strictly enforced for all system administrators and users accessing corporate applications. Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and contain mixed case, numbers, and symbols. Passwords are rotated quarterly, and accounts are locked out after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.

Section 8.5: Secure Authentication. Users log in using standard username and passwords. Multi-factor authentication is optional and recommended but not required. No password complexity rules or lockout settings are enforced.
cases.gold_evidence_phrase: Multi-factor authentication is optional and recommended but not required
